description: One Windows status icon per VS Code window to follow Codex in local and SSH workspaces.
commands.pin: Codex Status: associate a session with this window
config.enabled: Enable the icon for this window.
config.workspace_label: Custom letter or label (the first alphanumeric character is shown).
config.show_working_duration: Show the working duration in the tooltip.
config.exit_when_no_windows: Stop the Windows companion when all tracked VS Code windows are closed.
config.log_level: Technical logging level. Conversation content and credentials are never logged.
config.sessions_directory: Local session directory; empty uses CODEX_HOME/sessions or ~/.codex/sessions.
config.remote_sessions_directory: Session path on the SSH host; empty uses its CODEX_HOME/sessions or ~/.codex/sessions.
config.stale_working_minutes: Minutes during which session status stays recent without new Codex activity. The icon turns grey when it expires; account limit checks continue independently. Workspace-specific.
config.language: Language for icons, their settings dialog and runtime messages. Automatic follows the Windows display language: French for French Windows, English otherwise. Command titles and VS Code settings labels follow the VS Code display language.
config.notifications_enabled: Show a Windows notification when a task finishes or stops because credits are exhausted. Click the notification to open its VS Code window.
config.sound.chatgpt: Use the bundled ChatGPT sound, the default choice.
config.sound.custom: Play the custom WAV file when the notification appears.
config.notification_sound_file: Absolute local path to a PCM WAV file for the custom sound, up to 30 seconds and 5 MB.
